decisions.rationale: Vagus-mediated paroxysmal atrioventricular block is a specific type of paroxysmal complete atrioventricular block.
Neurally mediated (vasovagal) syncope is a different condition that may present with similar symptoms but is not directly related to paroxysmal complete atrioventricular block.
Carotid sinus hypersensitivity is a distinct condition that is not directly related to paroxysmal complete atrioventricular block.
